name: digital-health
description: Digital health metrics models, structs, calculations, and examples.
license: MIT OR Apache-2.0 OR BSD-3-Clause OR GPL-2.0-only OR GPL-3.0-only

rate_modules.fallible_return: Option<f64>, None iff a denominator argument is 0.0
rate_modules.panics: none of the public functions panic

money_modules.numeric_type: u32 counts in, rusty_money::Money<'static, rusty_money::iso::Currency> in and out
money_modules.fallible_return: Result<Money, rusty_money::MoneyError> — Err on currency mismatch or overflow, never on a zero count — except patient_acquisition_cost::cost_per_new_patient and episode_cost_reduction::cost_per_episode, which divide by a count and return Err(DivisionByZero) when it is zero
money_modules.panics: none of the public functions panic
money_modules.wrapping_policy: each function is a one-line pass-through directly to rusty_money's own Money::mul/Money::sub/Money::add/Money::div, not a generic wrapper — no FormattableCurrency type parameter
